included_source: src/SeExpr2 root core headers and implementation, plus src/SeExpr2/parser syntax-inspection scanner and template headers for the optional Python SDK
license: Apache License 2.0 with the upstream replacement Section 6
build_copy_changes: Disable automatic SE_EXPR_PLUGINS discovery; explicit host function registration remains available
Disable environment-selected expression debugging; diagnostics are explicitly owned by the host
Invoke the host thread-local instruction budget before each interpreter instruction
Reset the interpreter local-function call stack at evaluation entry to recover from cancellation
Use standard C++17 snprintf and log2 on Windows
Delete the Windows critical section through its concrete type
Expose the standard C++17 cbrt, asinh, acosh, atanh and trunc functions on every platform
Keep the default evaluation backend interpreter-based and independent of process environment
Isolate SDK graph resolution temporary state and evaluate selected dependencies in topological order
Adapt the optional JIT emitter to LLVM 14 typed builder and fixed-vector APIs
Insert no-throw JIT evaluation budget checks and capture callback exceptions for native reporting
Use bounded native string concatenation with terminator allocation in the optional JIT backend
Complete upstream parsed-but-disabled typed/inferred local functions and external prototypes in the AST/type environment, interpreter procedures and optional LLVM emitter
Keep nested local numeric/string calls isolated and preserve captured host-variable lifetimes
Validate bounded typed printf/sprintf formats and reject malformed argument lists before evaluation
Implement explicit cross-platform plugin loading with canonical path deduplication, deterministic directory discovery and registry-before-module cleanup
Validate AST structural depth iteratively before recursive preparation, dispose rejected/deep trees iteratively and preserve full signed source-byte positions
Keep syntaxOK independent of type preparation and reject excessive raw-SDK AST depth with a diagnostic
Correct whole-vector equality/inequality and scalar promotion in interpreter and optional LLVM paths
Preserve all typed SDK standard callback forms, varying lifetime aggregation, vector result shape and exceptions across the optional LLVM boundary
Prepare a private Python inspection-parser copy with virtual AST destruction and correct ordinary-call, vector-literal and nested-unary byte ranges
Bound Python inspection AST height during construction and parser recursion before deep-expression cleanup
